Meet the artist

Pooja Lade

From radiant brides to festive glam and photoshoot looks, Pooja brings out the best version of you with flawless HD and airbrush artistry, graceful hairstyling and perfect saree draping. Since February 2025, The Glam Makeover has been Nagpur's home for celebration-ready beauty and for training the next generation of makeup artists.
